method: Independent CSV-only reconstruction using Python csv and NumPy; did not import summarize_full_suite. Verified unique complete benchmark/prior/seed/method grid, rebuilt equal-subject and question-weighted seed-level aggregates, and recomputed every mean, p90, paired difference, percentage reduction and 10,000-draw PCG64 seed-20260913 multinomial seed-block bootstrap interval. Recomputed every aggregate per-subject better/tie/worse count with absolute tolerance 1e-10. Verified regressions.csv contains exactly every positive per-subject mean difference. Checked report conclusions against these values.
scope_limit: This review validates aggregation from the per-run metric CSV, not metric extraction from trajectories or Gittins simulation. Those have separate checks. Checkpoint CSVs were not reviewed here.
report_review: No numerical issues or substantive overclaims found. Improvements apply to four primary stability metrics, not universally to every metric; regret and budget-averaged drawdown have recorded regressions. AlpacaEval dataset-prior confidence intervals can include zero.
